description: This file defines the X509AuthHandler class, which handles authentication of HTTP clients using X.509 certificates within the Eclipse Hono framework. It validates client certificates and retrieves device credentials for authorization.

classes.name: X509AuthHandler
classes.description: Handles authentication of clients via X.509 certificates in HTTP requests, validating certificates and associating device credentials.

methods.name: X509AuthHandler
methods.description: Constructor for X509AuthHandler, initializes with a client authentication component and an authentication provider.

methods.name: parseCredentials
methods.description: Extracts and validates the client's X.509 certificate from the request, performing necessary authentication steps.

methods.name: processException
methods.description: Handles exceptions during authentication, sending appropriate error responses.
